name: teamcity-axi
description: Bounded read-only TeamCity evidence for coding agents

scripts.format: prettier --write src bin scripts tests schemas examples package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src bin scripts tests schemas examples package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json .github
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/executable-contract/*.test.mjs
